derived_notes.sample_confidence: high >= 34 GP, medium 17-33, low < 17. Always present when a consistency rate is.
derived_notes.trajectory_3yr: Least-squares slope of positional finish rank over the last 3 PLAYED seasons, x = real year. NEGATIVE = improving.
derived_notes.adp_edge: (Average ADP - TrueValue) in picks on the source's 12-team board. POSITIVE = market discount. The board and the league are both 12-team, so this is directly actionable and a 'full round' of drift is 12 picks.
derived_notes.td_dependency: TD share minus yardage share, position-appropriate block. Large positive = TD-dependent, i.e. regression exposure.
derived_notes.composite: Deliberately absent. The dimensions stay separate and visible.

evaluation_notes.what: Claude Rank — an opinion, not a source. Every input dimension remains separately visible under `derived`; this only blends them.
evaluation_notes.shrinkage: Rates are shrunk toward the positional mean with K=17 games of prior weight, so a rate on a small sample cannot outrank a better-evidenced one.
evaluation_notes.ordering: claude_value = vorp + claude_score * 20, where vorp is projected points over positional replacement (QB12, RB30, TE12, WR36) in a 12-team ESPN lineup. rank_delta is the disagreement with the market.
evaluation_notes.damping: Score is scaled by data completeness so a thin profile moves less.
